title: Skull Buzzing
subtitle: Test your grasp of Skull Buzzing — Static Build Up white noise, organic shift vs Voice to Skull, body-phase sequence, and true-timeline confirmation for Resonating Sols.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Skull Buzzing is the vessel’s white-noise registration of Static Build Up and Frequency Fracture—not random illness or Voice to Skull alone. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Skull Buzzing deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Read buzzing, exhaustion, heart spikes, and stillness as death throes of the parasitic grid; hold calm ground and anchor high-frequency light as the original realm returns.

questions.question: What is Subtle Buzzing in the Skull primarily an indicator of?

options.label: A
options.text: The Static Build Up during initial fracturing of the false 3D reality, signaling parasitic-overlay collapse and dormant memory-code awakening.
options.rationale: Subtle Buzzing in the Skull is a primary physiological indicator of Static Build Up as false 3D reality fractures, overlay collapses, and dormant memory codes awaken.

options.label: B
options.text: Proof that the false 3D reality is permanently solid and never begins to fracture or dissolve rather than Static Build Up buzzing as false 3D reality fractures and dormant codes awaken.
options.rationale: Buzzing marks the critical opening hours of frequency shift and overlay collapse—not permanent solid false reality.

options.label: C
options.text: Only a sports-day headache with no relation to the realm’s frequency shift or artificial matrix collapse rather than Static Build Up buzzing as false 3D reality fractures and dormant codes awaken.
options.rationale: The vessel translates energetic collapse of the artificial matrix into tangible sensations—not a sports-day headache alone.

options.label: D
options.text: A permanent medical failure with no link to Static Build Up, overlay collapse, or frequency shift at all rather than Static Build Up buzzing as false 3D reality fractures and dormant codes awaken.
options.rationale: Buzzing marks Static Build Up and frequency shift—not a permanent personal medical failure without grid meaning.

questions.hint: A named build-up during initial fracturing of false 3D reality.

questions.question: Why does the physical vessel register these sensations so directly?

options.label: A
options.text: Because Resonating Sols never feel anything until decades after the original realm fully returns, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: Signs mark critical opening hours of the frequency shift; the vessel registers collapse as it happens.

options.label: B
options.text: Because the physical vessel acts as a biological receiver, translating energetic collapse of the artificial matrix into tangible physical sensations.
options.rationale: The physical vessel is a biological receiver that translates artificial-matrix energetic collapse into tangible physical sensations.

options.label: C
options.text: Because only bank software glitches while the body remains sealed off from all grid and overlay changes, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: The body immediately registers environmental destabilization as density constructs vanish—not body-blind bank glitches alone.

options.label: D
options.text: Because the vessel is completely frequency-blind and never translates matrix collapse into any body sensation instead of the vessel as biological receiver translating artificial-matrix collapse into sensations.
options.rationale: The vessel acts as a biological receiver of matrix collapse—not frequency-blind to the shift.

questions.hint: Receiver role translating energetic collapse into the body.

questions.question: What are Signs in Body?

options.label: A

options.rationale: Signs in Body include Sol vessel sensations during overlay glitch—not NPC scripts alone.

options.label: B
options.text: Distinct physical and sensory symptoms experienced as the realm transitions and the false frequency overlay glitches.
options.rationale: Signs in Body are distinct physical and sensory symptoms as the realm transitions and the false frequency overlay glitches.

options.label: C
options.text: Permanent silence in every vessel with zero transition symptoms and zero overlay glitch registration.
options.rationale: Signs in Body mark transition and overlay glitch with clear sensory registration—not permanent silence.

options.label: D
options.text: Only legal documents with no physical or sensory symptoms during any frequency overlay glitch.
options.rationale: Signs in Body are lived physical and sensory symptoms—not legal documents alone.

questions.hint: Physical and sensory symptoms during realm transition and overlay glitch.

options.label: D
options.text: A physical sensation resembling background white noise, indicating atmospheric and energetic static build-up.
options.rationale: Subtle Buzzing in the Skull resembles background white noise and indicates atmospheric and energetic static build-up.

options.rationale: Static Build Up is pressure accumulation producing anomalies and glitches—not permanent calm without signs.

options.label: B
options.text: The accumulation of energetic pressure during the frequency fracture that causes physiological anomalies and environmental electronic glitches.
options.rationale: Static Build Up is accumulated energetic pressure during frequency fracture causing physiological anomalies and environmental electronic glitches.

options.label: C
options.text: Only Voice to Skull projections with no organic static and no electronic environmental mirror, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Organic Static Build Up includes internal buzzing mirrored by external electronic glitches—distinct from Voice to Skull.

options.label: D
options.text: Only a banking holiday with no frequency fracture and no physiological anomaly in any vessel and no hidden harvest architecture behind the scenes.
options.rationale: Static Build Up is frequency-fracture pressure with body and electronics effects—not a banking holiday alone.

options.rationale: Voice to Skull is mind-targeting parasitic projection; phone freezes mirror organic static, not the weapon itself.

options.label: C
options.text: An organic Sol lighthouse method that only broadcasts origin memory without any parasitic control intent instead of Voice to Skull projecting artificial thoughts to control, distract, or cause breakdowns.
options.rationale: Voice to Skull is parasitic weaponized projection—not an organic Sol lighthouse broadcast method.

options.label: D
options.text: Parasitic weaponized technology that projects artificial thoughts or voices into the head to control, distract, or cause breakdowns.
options.rationale: Voice to Skull is parasitic weaponized tech projecting artificial thoughts or voices into the head to control, distract, or cause breakdowns.

options.rationale: Drop in Tone is exhaustion and muted flattened environment—not unlimited energy and brilliant depth.

options.label: D
